title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our medical tourism services and how we can help you.

faqs.question: What does a medical tourism company in India do?
faqs.answer: A medical tourism company helps international patients coordinate healthcare in India, including specialist consultations, hospital selection, treatment planning, cost estimates, medical visa assistance, travel arrangements and follow-up support.

faqs.question: Can I get my medical reports reviewed before travelling to India?
faqs.answer: Yes. International patients can share their available medical reports and scans for preliminary review and coordination with suitable specialists.

faqs.question: Can Panacea Medcare help me choose a hospital in India?
faqs.answer: Yes. Panacea can help identify suitable hospitals and specialists based on the patient's condition, required treatment and other practical considerations.

faqs.question: How much does medical treatment in India cost?
faqs.answer: Treatment costs vary according to the diagnosis, procedure, hospital, specialist, medicines, length of stay and other medical requirements. Patients should obtain a case-specific estimate rather than rely on a generic price.

faqs.question: Does Panacea Medcare help with medical visas?
faqs.answer: Yes. Panacea assists international patients with medical visa documentation and hospital invitation requirements as part of the medical travel process.
